$comment: CI's own gate fixture (issue #20). Hand-built to stay R01-R03-clean once those rules stop being stubs; not the demonstrative example (examples/claude-oss.swarm.json), which ships its R03 finding on purpose per issue #3's own text. Non-trivial on purpose: a retry loop and a branch, so R01/R02/R03 are actually exercised rather than trivially satisfied by an empty swarm.
name: clean-fixture

coordinator.summary: Fixture root agent. Spawns builder, then routes on its handback: done goes to checker, failed retries builder once more.

builder.summary: Fixture worker agent. Reports done or failed.

checker.summary: Fixture reviewer agent. Reports approved or rejected; this flow ends either way.

edges._note: not terminal: both states are routed below (R03)
flow ends here either way; approved/rejected route nowhere further
one retry, then stop regardless of outcome
